#: A controller's system button with dashboardButton=system (run.py --cases recentre --script scripts/recentre.json --ini ini/recentre.ini --expect expect/recentre.json; the same under --shipped-defaults). Held for over a second it recentres once and opens no dashboard: on the stand-in, whose stage can't be moved, the seated origin goes under the head, facing the way it faces (the head stands away from the stage's origin, turned, and has moved and turned again before the second hold), the standing space stays, the game gets VREvent_SeatedZeroPoseReset and no chaperone event, and the controller that was held gets one pulse. Nothing happens before the second is up. Pressed, it opens the dashboard when it's let go, and closes it the same way.
